name: linkedin-social-mcp
description: LinkedIn (social): me, read_comments, reply_comment, read_mentions, delete, analytics_post. Every to

platform_mcp_linkedin_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_linkedin_client_id.description: Client id of a LinkedIn app with the Community Management API product (scopes w_organization_social, r_organization_social, plus openid profile for me).

platform_mcp_linkedin_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_linkedin_client_secret.description: The app's client secret (form body of the refresh_token grant at https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/accessToken).

platform_mcp_linkedin_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LINKEDIN_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_linkedin_refresh_token.description: Programmatic refresh token from the 3-legged flow (approved Marketing/Community Management partners; valid about one year). The runtime mints 60-day access tokens from it.

platform_mcp_linkedin_author_urn.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LINKEDIN_AUTHOR_URN
platform_mcp_linkedin_author_urn.description: Organization URN the member administers and acts as, e.g. urn:li:organization:5515715 (comment actor and the organizationalEntity of read_mentions).

tools.name: me
tools.description: OpenID Connect userinfo (sub, name, email) of the member behind the token; needs the openid and profile scopes.

tools.name: read_comments
tools.description: `post_id` is the share/ugcPost URN (urn:li:share:… or urn:li:ugcPost:…). id is the commentUrn to pass to reply_comment; created_at is epoch milliseconds.

tools.name: reply_comment
tools.description: Nested comment: `comment_id` is the parent commentUrn urn:li:comment:(urn:li:activity:…,…); the reply is authored by config author_urn. The docs' nested sample also sends `object` (the post URN), which this call cannot derive from the comment id.

tools.name: read_mentions
tools.description: Mentions of the organization (config author_urn) in posts; raw.generatedActivity is the mentioning share URN and raw.sourcePost the activity. No text or author is returned; `since` is not sent.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: `post_id` must be the URL-ENCODED share/ugcPost URN (urn%3Ali%3Ashare%3A123), as in 'DELETE https://api.linkedin.com/rest/posts/{encoded ugcPostUrn|shareUrn}'. 'Post deletions are idempotent' (204).

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: Social metadata of a share/ugcPost/comment URN: metrics carries reactionSummaries (per reaction type counts), commentSummary {count, topLevelCount} and commentsState.
